# Review Checklist

- [ ] Change matches approved scope (no scope leakage)
- [ ] Existing tests still pass
- [ ] New tests added for new/modified behavior
- [ ] No unnecessary abstractions or speculative code
- [ ] Proof artifact saved in verification/
- [ ] SEC files updated (BUILD_CONTEXT, NEXT_STEPS, TASK_BOARD)
- [ ] Review outcome: Accept / Accept With Follow-Ups / Block
